SLICE SHACK

A cozy little pizzeria. Customers never stop coming. Nothing is pre-made: fetch it, chop it, mix it, bake it.

W A S Dwalk (hold Shift to run), mouse to lookE or Left clickuse / pick up / hold to chop, knead, rollQ or Right clickput down what you hold / pick things upMmusic (or the jukebox)Hrecipe cheat-sheet

If the mouse can't lock in your browser: drag to look, arrow keys also turn.

How to run the shack

Dough (one batch = 9 dough balls)
  1. Storage room (back door): take flour, water, yeast, salt, sugar. You can carry all five at once.
  2. Kitchen back-left counter: put them into the big mixing bowl, hold E to knead.
  3. Take a dough ball, put it on any table, hold E to roll it into a pizza base. When the 9 are gone, mix a new batch.
Toppings
  1. Storage: take produce (4 at a time). Put it on a cutting board (left wall tables), hold E to chop.
  2. Take the chopped pile and pour it into the matching pan on the topping rails. Tomatoes into the blender make sauce.
Pizza
  1. Pizza base on the long table in front of the rails: click pans (sauce, cheese, toppings) to build it. Or hold the pizza and click pans.
  2. Pick it up, put it in an oven slot. Take it out when the lamp is green. Burnt = bad.
  3. Walk through the gap in the counter or reach over it: click the customer while holding the pizza. Match their order exactly.
